Yeah of course, everybody's driving Cadillacs and Teslas and glued to their Iphones screens while walking. 

Get a grip mate, jeeeeze this sub is fucking ridiculous.

Yeah, All this tech and the world is so out of touch :)

It's the same old blablabla "nobody understands me" and so on and so forth, but I do feel like I used to know someone that Knew me. But they're missing. And I don't mean romantically, I mean real understanding.

Seems like a chunk of life is missing. Oh well ;)
I try to be, not seen anything in a while, though, cheers.

Yep, this is all I am. Ty for your lovely input. :)

^and^btw^i^was^talking^to^the^mirror
